scope: Diagnostic traced autoregressive replay only. Not vLLM/serving throughput and no precision/policy conclusion.

policies.role: Selected BFP8/LoFi baseline on exact matching prompt IDs, seed and explicit cap only
P2 head-only BF16/HiFi4; attention/MLP/down remain BFP4/LoFi; descriptive only, excluded from speed ranking
policies.exclusion: Documented host contention invalidates idle-host ranking; distinct generated outputs/lengths prevent apples-to-apples speed interpretation.

comparison_limits: Rate is sum traced decode tokens divided by sum traced decode wall. Per-trial traced decode begins after first token and includes synchronous token-out readback; excludes prefill/first token and text decoding.
Only 18/108 P1 rows had a selected baseline with identical prompt IDs, seed and explicit cap.
Even exact pairs can diverge in output tokens and length; no causal precision conclusion. P2 host-contended and not speed-ranked.
intended_use: Compact values for REPORT.md / results.json configs_tried bookkeeping; consult linked inventory for exact paths, prompt/cap/seed strata, hashes, and paired rows.
